description: Machine-readable map from documented claims to the exact tracked command that regenerates them and the report file/field that records them (remediation R5.3). Commands run from the repository root with the locked solver venv (install/solver_requirements.txt). Long-running one-shot artifacts (final holdout, Aer benchmarks) are recorded reports: re-running them is a deliberate act, not part of routine verification.
entrypoint: bash verify.sh [quick|solver|full|gui] — solver tiers resolve the interpreter as: explicit PY=<python> (must import qiskit, hard-fails otherwise) > $VIRTUAL_ENV/bin/python > /root/qxapp-venv/bin/python (the setup_solver_venv.sh default, usually needs sudo). Non-root example: PY=<venv>/bin/python bash verify.sh quick. GUI tier: GUI_PY (default ~/qxapp_gui_testenv/bin/python, must import fastapi+pytest). Unknown tiers exit 2 with usage before running anything.
